landing.heroSubtitle: Chess and Checkers online, in real time
landing.heroText: Join a room, challenge a rival and play with a clock, chat, ELO and saved games. A board game platform with Dominican energy: pure strategy, quick duels, and a sober visual identity.
landing.gameSelectLabel: What do you want to play?
landing.chessTag: Online, bot, tournaments and ELO ranking
landing.damasTag: Online, bot and local mode -- no account needed
landing.featQuickText: Instant pairing with players at your level.
landing.featDuelText: Compete in games with a clock, chat and private rooms.
landing.featRankText: Raise your ELO and leave your mark on the hall of honor.
landing.featSafeText: Play with a protected account and carefully kept results.
landing.featuresTitle: A war table for every game
landing.featuresCopy: OZAMA CHESS feels like a real game client: clear enough to jump in fast, serious enough to compete, and elegant enough that every game carries weight.
landing.story1Text: Quick matchmaking, private rooms by code and direct challenges. Getting in is simple, but the game keeps all the tension of a competitive duel.
landing.story1Item1: Find a rival without any hassle
landing.story1Item2: Create a room and share the code
landing.story2Text: Every win adds to your ELO, every loss teaches you something, and your profile becomes a campaign record: stats, history and competitive growth.
landing.cardChatText: Chat with your rival without losing sight of the board or the clock.
landing.cardHistoryText: Every game leaves a trail so you can see your progress, your wins and your losses.
landing.cardTimeText: The clock sets the pace of the game and ends the duel when time runs out.
landing.cardBotText: Train at your own pace against the bot before challenging real players.
landing.cardDamasText: The Dominican classic arrives at OZAMA. Play online without registering, against the bot, or passing the turn with a friend.
landing.rankingCopy: See who rules the table: ELO, wins, games and streak in a clear table.
landing.howTitle: From the gate to the board
landing.howCopy: The flow needs to be fast, but not flat. Each step is presented as a piece within a visual path.
landing.step1Text: Create your account, choose your country and get ready to play.
landing.step2Text: Find a rival, create a private room, or enter with a code someone shared with you.
landing.step3Text: Move with full rules: check, checkmate, castling, en passant, promotion and draws.
landing.step4Text: Win, improve your ranking, and leave a record in your game history.
landing.finalText: OZAMA CHESS already has a full engine, rooms, profile, ranking and real-time games. Now the visual experience is starting to feel like the premium game it deserves to be.
landing.footerFlagLine: Blue, white and red in Ozama style

lobby.challengeDesc: Search for a player by name and challenge them directly.
